description: Turn a goal + a scope into a concrete, ordered attack scenario across multiple skills — not one technique in isolation. Load at the START of an engagement, on "where do I even begin", when a target has many surfaces, or to plan an objective-driven path (e.g. "reach domain admin", "prove data exfil"). This is how an agent decides what to try, in what order, and why.
